answer: Most convincing: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Each verification round randomly samples a quorum from a reputation grove where every member has staked collateral; votes are cross-checked in a peer mirror review, and standing wanders up or down as quorums audit each other. A sybil must age accounts and stake real value on many of them, so exposure burns the attacker's bonds - making fake identities unprofitable while honest graders stay cheap.
